root_cause_label: Heuristic Binning Without Cost-Model Feedback Loop
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent repeatedly tuned ad-hoc binning heuristics (bin step sizes, cluster thresholds) without ever calling cost_model.plan_metrics() to measure whether its plans met the required performance thresholds, resulting in blind iteration that never converged on a valid solution.
t_err_evidence: Step 11 shows the first full implementation of optimized_packer.py committed to a pure heuristic binning strategy (prompt bins + gen bins) with no calls to CostModel or plan_metrics(). The agent had read cost_model.py in full at step 6 and understood the evaluation API, yet chose an approach that never uses it. This is the earliest step where a specific wrong strategic decision is encoded.
t_commit_evidence: From step 11 onward, every subsequent edit only changes numeric parameters (bin_step: 128->64->96, gen_step: 100->50->75, cluster threshold: 128->64) within the same heuristic framework. The agent never pivots to calling plan_metrics(); the failure is locked in as soon as the initial implementation is committed at step 11.
trigger_explanation: The task specification provided cost_model.py explicitly as the evaluation tool to optimize against, and its plan_metrics() function exposes the four required threshold values (cost, pad_ratio, p95_latency, sequential_timecost). The agent read cost_model.py at step 6 but then wrote an optimizer that never calls it, effectively ignoring the core requirement to measure and satisfy the thresholds. This is spec_neglect: the agent dropped the explicit task requirement to use the cost model as a feedback signal.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 10, 16, 18, 21, 25, 31, 33, 36, 38 all show empty terminal output when the optimized_packer.py script is run. The script produces no printed metrics, no pass/fail signals, and no numeric output of any kind. A correct optimizer would print plan_metrics() results; the persistent silence was a signal that the script was not evaluating anything. The agent never reacted to this absence of output.
